an6.29:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi:
an6.29:1.3: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:1.4: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi.
an6.29:1.6: dutiyampi kho āyasmā udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:1.7: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi.
an6.29:1.9: tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
an6.29:2.4: “idha bhante bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ, dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an6.29:3.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
an6.29:4.3: idha bhante, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… [paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe…] tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.29:4.4: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃbahulīkataṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati. (2)
an6.29:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, bhikkhu ālokasaññaṃ manasikaroti, divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭhāti. yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā,
an6.29:5.2: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
an6.29:5.3: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃbahulīkataṃ ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati. (3)
an6.29:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adhokesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati:
an6.29:6.2: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhī aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghānikā lasikā muttanti.
an6.29:6.3: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ kāmarāgassa pahānāya saṃvattati. (4)
an6.29:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhante bhikkhu seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātaṃ.
an6.29:7.3: “ayampi kho kāyo evaṃ dhammo evambhāvī etaṃ anatīto”ti.
an6.29:8.1: seyyathāpi vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ suvānehi vā khajjamānaṃ sigālehi vā khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ,
an6.29:8.3: “ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī etaṃ anatīto”ti.
an6.29:9.1: seyyathāpi vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhisaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nahārusambandhaṃ …pe…
an6.29:9.4: aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disāvidisāsu vikkhittāni: aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅghaṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūraṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭaṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ. so imameva kāyaṃ evaṃ upasaṃharati: “ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī etaṃ anatīto”ti. seyyathāpi vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ, aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇupanihāni …pe… aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni. terovassikāni …pe… aṭṭhikāni pūtīni cuṇṇakajātāni.
an6.29:9.6: ‘ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evambhāvī etaṃ anatīto”ti.
an6.29:9.7: idambhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ asmimānasamugghātāya saṃvattati. (5)
an6.29:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhante bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.29:10.2: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ. anekadhātu paṭivedhāya saṃvattatī.
an6.29:11.2: tena hi tvaṃ ānanda idampi chaṭṭhaṃ anussatiṭṭhānaṃ dhārehi: (6)
an6.29:11.3: idhānanda bhikkhu satova abhikkamati, satova paṭikkamati, satova tiṭṭhati, satova nisīdati, satova seyyaṃ kappeti, satova kammaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an6.29:11.4: idaṃ ānanda anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃbhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ satisampajaññāya saṃvattatīti.
